task_summary: Add mobile hamburger navigation menu to landing page
problem_statement: Navigation component shows desktop nav links with 'hidden md:flex'. Mobile users only see the logo and a 'Basla' button linking to /register. No hamburger menu icon or slide-out navigation exists for mobile viewports.

patterns.responsive_design: Uses Tailwind CSS responsive modifiers (md:, lg:, etc.)
patterns.mobile_breakpoint: md: (768px) - desktop nav shows at md and above
patterns.component_structure: Navigation component is embedded in landing page (app/page.tsx)

existing_implementations.description: No existing mobile navigation implementation found
existing_implementations.mobile_behavior: Currently only shows logo and 'Basla' (register) button on mobile
existing_implementations.desktop_behavior: Shows full navigation links (Features, Pricing, Login) at md: breakpoint and above

technical_requirements.add_hamburger_icon: Display hamburger menu icon on mobile (< md: breakpoint)
technical_requirements.add_mobile_menu: Create slide-out or dropdown menu for mobile navigation
technical_requirements.menu_links: Include same links as desktop: Features, Pricing, Login/Register
technical_requirements.toggle_functionality: Open/close menu on hamburger icon click
technical_requirements.responsive_behavior: Hide hamburger on desktop (md: and above), show desktop nav
technical_requirements.accessibility: Add proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation support

ui_considerations.animation: Smooth slide or fade animation for menu open/close
ui_considerations.overlay: Optional backdrop overlay when menu is open
ui_considerations.z_index: Ensure menu appears above other content
ui_considerations.styling: Match existing design system and Tailwind conventions
